_provenance.description: Full deterministic transitions recorded before reward extraction; separately replayed against the committed baseline with exact equality. No PX4/Gazebo or policy training involved.

reward_interface.rate_aggregation: sum of three squared degree/s errors, then cap

horizon_success.aggregation: each axis separately: sqrt(mean over all episode steps of squared degree/s error); all three strictly below threshold

reward_interface.legacy_component_slot_peak_pwm: disabled: collective thrust is controlled by PX4
reward_interface.motor_command_source: latest actual PX4 actuator_motors.control normalized ESC commands in applied_pwm
reward_interface.slew_input: (current accepted requested normalized torque - previous accepted requested normalized torque) / dt
reward_interface.slew_aggregation: mean over three axes of B(torque_rate / slew_scale_per_s), B(x)=x^2/(1+x^2)
reward_interface.slew_history_initialization: zero torque before the first accepted policy action of each episode
reward_interface.saturation_input: current accepted normalized torque, each of three signed axes independently
reward_interface.saturation_comparison: abs(torque) >= threshold; zero torque is not saturated
reward_interface.motor_saturation_role: diagnostic only; does not affect native torque reward or tracking bonus
reward_interface.tracking_bonus_gate: each true rate error strictly <5 deg/s; no failure; no saturated torque axis
reward_interface.collective_thrust_control: native PX4; no actor thrust observation or thrust action
